headline: Will Flowserve’s New Services-Focused Director Quietly Reshape Its Value-Creation Strategy (FLS)?
summary: Flowserve Corporation recently amended its by-laws to expand its Board of Directors from nine to ten members and elected Ajay Agrawal, Carrier Global’s Chief Business Development Officer and Senior Vice President, Global Services, to the newly created board seat effective August 5, 2026. By adding Agrawal, who brings deep experience in aftermarket services, portfolio leadership, and M&A, to key board committees, Flowserve is signaling an increased emphasis on growth opportunities and...
